query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_cars,
  SUM(CASE WHEN evdbVehicleId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_evdb_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN evdbVehicleId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_evdb_id
FROM cars;

SELECT c.make, c.model, c.evdbVehicleId, ev.drivetrain_type
FROM cars c
JOIN evVehicles ev ON c.evdbVehicleId = ev.id
LIMIT 10;
